dashboards.name: NYC taxi — January 2025
dashboards.description: Curated January 2025 NYC yellow and green taxi trips.

charts.title: Daily trips
charts.description: All curated taxi services combined by pickup date.
charts.sql: SELECT pickup_date, SUM(trip_count) AS trips FROM OpenSource.nyc_taxi.daily_trips GROUP BY pickup_date ORDER BY pickup_date

charts.title: Daily gross amount (cents)
charts.description: Curated trip totals in stored cents, by pickup date.
charts.sql: SELECT pickup_date, SUM(total_amount_cents) AS gross_amount_cents FROM OpenSource.nyc_taxi.daily_trips GROUP BY pickup_date ORDER BY pickup_date

charts.title: Service mix
charts.description: Trip count split across yellow and green service records.
charts.sql: SELECT service_type, SUM(trip_count) AS trips FROM OpenSource.nyc_taxi.daily_trips GROUP BY service_type ORDER BY trips DESC

dashboards.name: COVID-19 — reported values
dashboards.description: WHO-reported values; reporting revisions and gaps remain in the source.

charts.title: Reported cases in 2020
charts.description: Daily reported new cases in 2020; not an estimate of infections.
charts.sql: SELECT report_date, new_cases AS reported_cases FROM OpenSource.covid.reported_by_date WHERE report_date >= '2020-01-01' AND report_date < '2021-01-01' ORDER BY report_date

charts.title: Reported cases by WHO region
charts.description: Sum of reported new cases grouped by WHO region.
charts.sql: SELECT who_region, SUM(new_cases) AS reported_cases FROM OpenSource.covid.reported_cases GROUP BY who_region ORDER BY reported_cases DESC

charts.title: Highest reported cumulative cases
charts.description: Country records by reported cumulative cases, not estimated infections.
charts.sql: SELECT country, MAX(cumulative_cases) AS reported_cumulative_cases FROM OpenSource.covid.reported_cases GROUP BY country ORDER BY reported_cumulative_cases DESC LIMIT 15

dashboards.name: Climate and energy
dashboards.description: NASA GISTEMP anomalies and an imported Our World in Data energy snapshot.

charts.title: Annual GISTEMP anomaly
charts.description: Mean of available NASA GISTEMP monthly anomalies in °C relative to the 1951–1980 baseline; the latest year may be incomplete.
charts.sql: SELECT year, AVG(anomaly_deg_c) AS annual_anomaly_deg_c FROM OpenSource.climate_energy.global_temperature_monthly WHERE anomaly_deg_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

charts.title: Global low-carbon electricity share
charts.description: OWID snapshot rows labelled World; percent share of electricity.
charts.sql: SELECT year, low_carbon_share_elec FROM OpenSource.climate_energy.energy WHERE country = 'World' AND low_carbon_share_elec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year

charts.title: Low-carbon electricity share in 2023
charts.description: Country observations in the imported OWID energy snapshot, percent of electricity.
charts.sql: SELECT country, low_carbon_share_elec FROM OpenSource.climate_energy.energy WHERE year = 2023 AND iso_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(iso_code) = 3 AND low_carbon_share_elec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY low_carbon_share_elec DESC LIMIT 15

dashboards.name: Archived Open LLM leaderboard
dashboards.description: Archived leaderboard file; it is not a current model ranking.

charts.title: Average score by architecture
charts.description: Archived entries with a reported average score.
charts.sql: SELECT architecture, AVG(average) AS average_score FROM OpenSource.ai_benchmarks.open_llm_results WHERE architecture IS NOT NULL AND architecture <> '' AND average IS NOT NULL GROUP BY architecture ORDER BY average_score DESC LIMIT 15

charts.title: Average score by precision
charts.description: Archived entries grouped by reported precision.
charts.sql: SELECT precision, AVG(average) AS average_score FROM OpenSource.ai_benchmarks.open_llm_results WHERE precision IS NOT NULL AND average IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precision ORDER BY average_score DESC

charts.title: Top archived leaderboard entries
charts.description: Highest archived average per model; availability may have changed.
charts.sql: SELECT fullname, MAX(average) AS average_score FROM OpenSource.ai_benchmarks.open_llm_results WHERE fullname IS NOT NULL AND fullname <> '' AND average IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fullname ORDER BY average_score DESC LIMIT 20
